truth_layout: vehicle[3]=x_enu_m, vehicle[4]=y_enu_m, vehicle[5]=z_ned_m (down positive); z_enu = -vehicle[5]; step = frame (1 ms tick)

feedback_gap.meaning: required environment feedback withheld for rows with 30000 < frame <= 30020; the last envelope is stale at resume and the joint scene freezes at that completed boundary; a fresh query is the explicit recovery

notes: Recorded real ArduCopter truth from a previous physics validation run; no new physics is computed and nothing is sent to a flight controller.
